summary: Karman Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an underwritten secondary offering of 14,000,000 common shares (plus a 30-day underwriter option for up to 2,100,000 additional shares) by selling stockholders at $61.00 per share, which closed on June 1, 2026. The company is the issuer but receives no proceeds; it agreed to a 90-day lock-up on share issuance. The filing involves customary underwriting provisions and an indemnification clause. This is a routine secondary offering, not a special situation, as it does not involve a merger, acquisition, activist campaign, restructuring, or other transformative event. It is a standard capital markets transaction.
